description: Policy for the future independent RedCap shared knowledge repository. The repository is append-only for authored entries and index-first for retrieval.
user_namespace_rule: entries live under users/<user_slug>/ so team members can contribute to the same repository without mixing authorship
retrieval_rule: read catalog and metadata first; use rg/FTS for exact recall; only load entry bodies after the caller has a precise evidence need
dedupe_rule: before append, compute a normalized fingerprint and reject exact duplicates; near-duplicate review remains a Prism or human-review concern until semantic retrieval exists
remote_boundary: Gitee remote creation and binding are intentionally deferred until the user provides the remote repository.
